lines.text: David and thirty thousand chosen men set out for Baale of Judah to bring up the ark of God.
At the threshing floor of Gilgal, Uzzah grabbed the ark as the oxen stumbled, and God struck him down.
David took the ark to Obed-edom the Gittite's house, where it stayed three months and the LORD blessed him.
When those carrying the ark had gone six paces, David sacrificed a ram and a fattened calf.
